fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Mechanized hover Level I formations gave the Word of Blake Militia its fastest ground-mobile infantry, capable of crossing water obstacles and open terrain at speeds that outpaced wheeled or tracked alternatives. Their speed made them effective pursuit forces when Protectorate populations attempted to flee contested areas. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
